ObjectName: Joseph-Désiré Mobutu at press conference on September 14, 1960 asserting control over DRC goverment
ImageDescription: Joseph-Désiré Mobutu holding a paper saying "Hands off the Congo" (in French) with picture of Nikita Khrushchev, amidst fight over Congolese governance.
Credit: Published in 1960 in the US, credited to the Associated Press (https://www.newspapers.com/image/674846403/) which did not renew copyrights. HQ version from https://www.cfr.org/books/lumumba-plot, credited to the AP.
